description_en: Configures a conditional forwarder and trust relationship for a high-definition experience (HDX)-based office network (formerly workspace). You can call the operation to configure a trust relationship for an enterprise Active Directory (AD) office network
description_zh: 对于采用HDX协议的办公网络（原工作区），需要配置条件转发器和信任关系后方可正常使用。可调用本接口为AD办公网络配置信任关系
kebab_example: aliyun ecd config-ad-connector-trust --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-7784180000 --trust-key password123000 --rds-license-domain true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigADConnectorTrust

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise AD office network
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The trust password. You can specify the password when you configure a trust relationship between the AD domain and the ecd.acs domain
parameters.help_zh: 信任密码。该密码为AD域中配置信任关系（即与无影ecd.acs建立信任关系）时设置的密码
parameters.name: trust_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to configure a trust password for the Remote Desktop Services (RDS) License Domain of the enterprise AD office network.

Valid values:

*   true: configures a trust password for the RDS License Domain of the AD office network.

*   false: configures a trust password for a regular enterprise AD office network
parameters.help_zh: 判断是否是为AD办公网络的RDS License Domain配置信任密码
parameters.name: rds_license_domain
